title_en: BIP: Futures of Bioeconomy of Sociobiodiversity
abstract_en: Blended Intensive Programme for first- and second-year Master students on bioeconomy, sociobiodiversity, futures thinking and anticipation, organised by UPEC (AEI International School) with Università Federico II of Naples and Copenhagen Business School.
description_en: Introductory online sessions with short preparatory readings and activities (19 and 23 October 2026) prepare an on-site week of group work at UPEC from 26 to 30 October 2026. The programme brings together business, design, economics and futures studies with lecturers from the four partner universities and invited speakers.
prerequisites_en: English level B2 or higher; first- or second-year Master students of Aurora universities.

title_en: Tabletop Role-Playing Games and Managerial Skills
abstract_en: Game-based learning course of Université Paris-Est Créteil that uses physical tabletop role-playing games to build management soft skills.
description_en: Students work in international teams to create Dungeon Crawl Classics scenarios for a 2027 contest run with Goodman Games, developing creativity, decision making and collaboration. The previous edition gathered 35 students from 11 countries and 14 teachers from 8 countries.
learning_outcomes_en: Build soft management skills (creativity, decision making, collaboration) through game-based learning.
